notes: Camera bubble controls actually fixed: the control pill (menu / pause / retake / stop) now sits one window layer ABOVE the bubble, so it can no longer be buried behind the camera circle when recording starts — that z-order race is why the buttons 'disappeared'. Clicking the bubble now always reveals the controls (this had been silently unwired for several builds). Retake now requires a confirming second tap — a stray tap used to silently delete your last clip and restart recording. Bigger buttons with strict hit zones so Stop can't be mistaken for Retake. Every control press is logged by name, so problems are diagnosable from the log. Recordings now save directly to your Downloads folder; the Library lists both Downloads and previously saved recordings.
